decision: A frozen protocol is not equivalent to an implemented safeguard. Operational claims must distinguish FROZEN, QUALIFIED, WIRED, and ACTIVE states. ACTIVE requires protocol freeze, qualification evidence, explicit production-workflow wiring, and CI verification of the implementation-status record.

triggering_evidence.legacy_architecture: external wrapper timeout without native electronic checkpoint
triggering_evidence.correction: Do not describe the native checkpoint as set up or active for run 33329096616.

consequence: No future production-control mechanism may be described as implemented merely because its protocol file exists. Governance CI must verify deployment state, and the implementation registry is authoritative for operational-status wording.
